name: mobile.claw/ai-tools
title: claw.mobile AI tools catalogue
description: Catalogue of 33 AI coding and app-building tools: prices from vendor pages, comparisons, search.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the tools in the claw.mobile catalogue (33 AI app builders, AI IDEs, terminal agents and coding assistants) with plans, prices and price provenance. Optional filters: type and free (true = only tools with a free plan, false = only tools without one). Same data as GET https://claw.mobile/api/tools.

type.description: Tool type: ai-ide (AI IDE), app-builder (App Builder), terminal-agent (Terminal Agent), assistant (Assistant), specialized (Specialized)

free.description: true: only tools with a free plan; false: only tools without one

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full record for one tool by slug (e.g. "cursor", "lovable", "claude-code"): plans, prices, features, pros, cons, rating (null if unrated), price source, vendor website and claw.mobile page. Same data as GET https://claw.mobile/api/tools/{slug}.

slug.description: Tool slug, as returned by list_tools

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2 or 3 tools by slug: price, type, best-for, skill level, rating and free tier differences, plus a rule-based verdict. Same data as GET https://claw.mobile/api/tools/compare.

tools.name: tool_pricing
tools.description: Every tool’s starting price and plans, cheapest first, each with priceSource, priceVerifiedAt and priceSourceUrl (the vendor pricing page it was read from). Same data as GET https://claw.mobile/api/tools/pricing.

tools.name: find_tool
tools.description: Match a plain-language need (e.g. "cheapest AI app builder with a free plan", "terminal coding agent under $25") to tools in the catalogue. How it ranks: Keyword match over the catalogue, no model involved. 1) Words in the request set filters: "app builder"/"no-code"/"no code" -> type App Builder; "ide"/"editor" -> AI IDE; "terminal"/"cli" -> Terminal Agent; "free" -> only tools with a free plan; "under $N"/"below $N"/"less than $N" -> starting price at most $N; "beginner"/"non-coder"/"non-technical" -> skill level Beginner. 2) Remaining tools are scored by how many other request words appear in the name, bestFor, features and type. 3) Order: if the request says cheap/cheapest/budget/affordable, lowest starting price first; otherwise highest match score, then claw.mobile rating (unrated last), then lowest starting price. Starting price is the first dollar figure the vendor lists, which may be an annual-billing rate or per user. The response repeats the filters it read from the request.

need.description: What the person wants, in their words

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Find claw.mobile's researched articles on a topic (e.g. "Lovable credits", "AI agent memory", "Bolt vs Replit"), best matches first, each with title, summary, date and URL so an answer can cite it. Each article lists its sources at the end of the page.

query.description: What the reader wants to know
